**General**
- Home and End keys now work in the various browsers (texture, thing type, etc.)
- Fixed toolbar buttons not activating if the mouse moved while clicking
- Fixed various issues handling unicode text and file paths
- [Windows] Fixed error on startup on Windows 7

**Game Formats & Features**
- Updated DECOHack language definition (thanks @electricbrass)
- Added support for the Heretic+Hexen port (thanks @Gaerzi)
- Fixed Eternity Line_QuickPortal special (thanks @vanjac)

**Resource Editor**
- Added ability to copy+paste gfx offsets
- Added a 'Quick Run Archive' toolbar button (thanks @107zxz)
- Various fixes/improvements to MIDI playback and soundfont detection
- [Windows] Fixed slow scrolling of the entry list/tree
- [Linux] The executable path for run archive can now be set to any text value (eg. "gzdoom") on linux
- [Linux] Don't use inaccessable directories when optimizing PNG images (thanks @Person-Who-Exists)
- [Linux] Fixed crashes on entry list updates (entry added/deleted, etc.) while filtering is active
- Fixed parsing `//$` editor comments in DECORATE and ZScript
- Fixed translation range not updating correctly if the mouse was dragged outside the palette while selecting the range
- Fixed inability to use `^` character when renaming an entry
- Fixed DECOHack compilation always creating a new `DEHACKED` entry even if one already exists

**Texture Editor**
- Double clicking a TEXTUREx entry will now open only that entry in the texture editor
- Limited the number of TEXTUREx entries initially opened to 5 when launching the texture editor via toolbar or menu
- Fixed patch offsets being set to the wrong value when double-clicking a patch in the browser during 'replace patch' action
- [Linux] Fixed possible crash on opening the texture editor with certain system configurations

**Map Editor**
- Added ability to auto-align on the Y-axis and improved X-axis auto alignment (thanks @ralfgerlich)
- Added 'Enter 3d mode at mouse cursor' action and keybind (`Shift`+`Q`)
- Fixed the 'overlapping things' map check
- Fixed selection box showing up when it shouldn't after clicking back into the map editor from a menu
